name: AVEN
description: A tactile workspace website with floating interface cards, soft materials, thoughtful motion, and a complete seven-page experience.
tagline: Clarity and momentum for ambitious teams.

notes.layout: floating capsule navigation, overlapping live workspace cards, dashboard, feature tabs, integrations, selectable plans, stories, FAQ, and contact
notes.motion: staggered card entrances, softly floating integration tiles, animated tab transitions, one-time scroll reveals, reduced-motion and pause support
notes.interaction: select and sort people; switch feature panels and plans; preselect a plan in the inquiry; save, restore, copy, and clear a local draft; explore seven complete pages
notes.provenance: Reference-inspired adaptation of Grovia, with a fictional identity and local demo behavior.
